status: FROZEN AT PREP — PREP_READY only. NOT an execution authorization.
source_spec: GitHub Issue #9 (mickaellall116-cmyk/quality-flow-scanner-v5), opened 2026-10-14T20:01:11Z; dispatch Issue #1 comment 6177187528; prior analysis Issue #1 comment 6175664023.
question: Does structured multi-role ideation (Arm B: proposer / skeptic / feasibility / synthesis, same underlying model) add unique, falsifiable, nonduplicate Quality Flow strategy hypotheses versus one strong-model adversarial brainstorm (Arm A), at equal total inference + review budget?
explicitly_not: Not a profitability study. No returns, Sharpe, drawdown, backtest, or paper-trading claims. Output is candidate test specifications only.

seeds.S2: Exits that retain trend runners while controlling adverse excursion
seeds.selection_note: Frozen in Issue #9; chosen without consulting outcome/holdout performance.

arms.A_control: One capable model: phase 1 proposes (seed prompt), phase 2 adversarially self-critiques under one fixed prompt and emits the final card set. Same model/provider/version as Arm B.
arms.B_treatment: Same underlying model/provider: four segregated roles (proposer, skeptic, feasibility specialist, synthesis/deduplicator). Round 1: proposer; skeptic + feasibility review independently. Round 2: one proposer revision; synthesis emits final set. Max 2 rounds. Role diversity is NOT model independence and must never be reported as independent votes.
arms.isolation: Per seed, processing order randomized by a coin recorded and hashed in the run manifest BEFORE any call. Arm outputs sealed (hashed) before the other arm starts; no cross-arm material before blind screening.

budgets_per_arm_per_seed.billed_tokens_definition: input + output + reasoning tokens, as reported by the provider per call and summed in the resource ledger. Reasoning tokens count in full (OmniRoute pilot finding).
budgets_per_arm_per_seed.call_cap_note: Call caps differ structurally (B has 4 roles); fairness is anchored on identical billed-token, cost, and wall-time caps. The asymmetry is disclosed, not hidden.
budgets_per_arm_per_seed.cost_rule: Hard zero: no call at all unless the pinned route's incremental cost is verified $0 BEFORE the run (provider catalog/account evidence in the run manifest). If the pinned model is not verifiably zero-incremental, execution is unauthorized under this protocol.
budgets_per_arm_per_seed.budget_mismatch_tolerance: If billed tokens for a seed pair diverge between arms by more than 5% of the cap (6,000 tokens), the pair is flagged BUDGET_MISMATCH and its comparison is inconclusive (reported, not silently compared).

model_pin_requirements_at_execution: ONE model/provider/version pinned identically for both arms, recorded in the run manifest before any call.
Provider must expose per-call token usage including reasoning tokens (the ledger cannot be reconstructed otherwise).
Route must be verifiably zero incremental cost (see cost_rule).
OmniRoute is FORBIDDEN as the route: adjudicated FAIL/PARK 2026-10-14 (utility pilot: HTTP 200 with empty outputs; its cost ledger is empty and proves nothing about charges).
No mid-run model substitution or silent fallback; any provider-side fallback detected in logs voids the affected arm-seed and stops the run for adjudication.

rubric_blinded_acceptance.rule: A candidate PASSES only if ALL five gates pass (Issue #9 rubric). Grading is blind: arm labels stripped, packet order shuffled under a recorded seed, blinding key held by a non-grader until scores are locked.

gates.G1_testable: Machine-testable rule AND measurable outcome with an explicit null/control.
gates.G2_no_leakage: No obvious timing/lookahead or survivorship violation, OR a precisely specified feasible PIT route for every flagged input.
gates.G3_data_available: Source/data requirements available and suitable for 4H signal timing; otherwise the candidate is parked DATA_BLOCKED (not passed, not failed).
gates.G4_not_killed_family: Not equivalent to a previously killed/tested family (registry export match), unless a materially_different_mechanism justification survives human confirmation (ADJACENCY_FLAGGED path).
gates.G5_execution_realistic: Realistic observable execution with stated costs/slippage and unambiguous timestamps.

rubric_blinded_acceptance.synonym_rule: Synonyms/rewordings of one mechanism count once: duplicates are detected on family_id + rule signature and recorded as DUPLICATE_OF the first accepted instance; never counted as independent ideas.
rubric_blinded_acceptance.auditor_duties: Score anonymous candidates; record per-gate failures, duplicate decisions, provenance/factual errors, leakage flags, review minutes per candidate, and any adjudicator disagreement (unresolved disagreement = candidate not passed).
rubric_blinded_acceptance.duplicate_cluster_accounting: If the same mechanism is accepted from both arms (a cross-arm duplicate cluster), the blind grader keeps exactly one surviving copy (packet order decides which physical copy; the choice is arm-blind and arbitrary) and marks the other DUPLICATE_OF. For metrics, the idea belongs to BOTH arms' accepted sets, so it is incremental for neither arm. Within one arm, duplicates collapse to one accepted unique specification.

metrics.primary: Incremental accepted unique test specifications per total inference resource + auditor review time, on paired seeds. Report the absolute numerator AND the complete budgets separately; no ratios against zero dollars.
metrics.statistics_warning: 3 seeds support no statistical generalization. Results are an engineering readout for this version only.

park_fail: Arm B yields ZERO incremental accepted unique specifications across all 3 seed pairs.
Arm B does not strictly improve the primary metric versus Arm A.
More than 20% of all candidate cards are untestable after screening (threshold from Issue #1 comment 6175664023, preregistered as an engineering heuristic).
immediate_stop: Credential or private-data leakage into any prompt/output.
Unverified spend or any nonzero incremental charge.
Any attempt to trigger a backtest, promotion, or production change from generated output.
Blinding breach before scores are locked (affected pair restarts only under a new authorization, or is reported inconclusive).
stop_conditions.no_prompt_optimization: Prompts are frozen for this version. Do not tune prompts after inspecting outcomes; a changed prompt set is a new version requiring new prep.

decisive_vs_inconclusive.decisive: All 3 seed pairs complete inside frozen budgets with blind scoring, dedupe, and complete ledgers; a park/fail rule fires, or Arm B strictly improves the primary metric with budgets inside tolerance.
decisive_vs_inconclusive.inconclusive: Any seed pair BUDGET_MISMATCH; model substitution/fallback; blinding breach; fewer than 3 pairs completed; unresolved adjudicator disagreement on the deciding candidates; cost verification impossible for the pinned route.

preservation_requirements: Provider/model/version, prompts (by hash), parameters, seed order coin, all raw outputs, token/cost ledger, anonymized packet + blinding key (sealed until scoring locks), per-gate scores, rejected/duplicate reasons — all hashed into the run manifest.
authorization_boundary: This protocol authorizes NOTHING beyond the offline prep that produced it. A run requires: (1) Mike's explicit execution authorization; (2) ChatGPT review of this prep packet; (3) an execution-time model pin satisfying every requirement above, with zero-incremental-cost verification evidence; (4) a fresh run manifest. Any later backtest of surviving specifications requires separate approval and the independently qualified historical feed, clean bar grid, untouched holdouts, cost model, multiple-testing accounting, and portfolio replay (Issue #9).
